entities.summary: Darrell Elvin Dexter is a Canadian lawyer, journalist and former naval officer who served as the 27th premier of Nova Scotia from 2009 to 2013. A member of the Nova Scotia New Democratic Party, he served as party leader from 2001 to 2013. He became Premier in 2009 after his party defeated the governing Progressive Conservative Party, leading the first NDP government in Atlantic Canada and the second east of Manitoba. His government was defeated in the 2013 election, becoming the first Nova Scotia government in 131 years to be denied a second mandate; Dexter himself was defeated in his constituency by 21 votes.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Darrell Dexter's tenure as Premier of Nova Scotia from 2009 to 2013 marked a significant shift in Atlantic Canadian politics, as he led the first NDP government in the region and implemented various policy initiatives. His defeat in the 2013 election was notable for being the first time a provincial government had been denied a second mandate in over 130 years.
